real: T-14 Armata (2A82-1M 125 mm, coax PKTM, 12.7 mm Kord RWS, Afghanit APS)
shape: refs: none; the old builder: a low flat-faced hull on seven road wheels, a low unmanned turret set well back with ERA, APS radar panels at its corners, a remote MG, a panoramic sight mast, side screens with ERA, a rear cage; 7.79 x 3.07 x 2.3 m with the gun (0.72 x the real tank); team bands on the roof and both sides; no real insignia.

features.feature: the long low hull (Team) with the flat upper glacis, the lower nose plate, the stepped rear
the driver's capsule hatch in the middle of the glacis with three periscopes
seven road wheels a side, the rear sprocket, the front idler on its arm, a linked track
skirts: reactive bricks over the front four wheels, hinged plates behind, a rubber edge
the engine deck grilles, the rear exhaust louvre, the slat cage over the rear
the unmanned faceted turret set well back, its bolted cheek modules
the slim mantlet and gaiter, the 125 mm gun in its thermal sleeve with clamps, the coax
Afghanit: four AESA radar panels on the turret corners, five hard-kill tubes a side, the APS pivot
soft-kill grenade launchers on the roof's rear corners
the commander's panoramic sight mast, the gunner's sight head, a hatch
the remote 12.7 mm station on a raised ring (roof-gun rule)
the bustle box with stowage and a tarp roll, toolboxes, jerrycans, tow cable, lamps, hooks, mudflaps, whips, Team bands

budget.note: heavy class: over the maximum is information only

team_zones: bands on the hull sides and the turret roof
wreck: the turret flies off (Turret); the runtime breaks the tracked hull
